Rules in this chunk:
31. The current interaction has a field named has been escalated which is a boolean maintained by the runtime.
32. A tool call is one of the defined write tool calls and carries typed parameters.
33. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the affected customer exists in the database.
34. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the affected account exists in the database.
35. A call to apply a refund where the refund type is MERCHANT_REFUND or DISPUTE_REFUND or SECTION_75_REFUND requires that the referenced transaction exists in the database.
36. A call to apply a refund where the refund type is MERCHANT_REFUND or DISPUTE_REFUND or SECTION_75_REFUND requires that the referenced transaction has status POSTED or DISPUTED.
37. A call to apply a refund where the refund type is SECTION_75_REFUND requires that the referenced transaction has its section seventy five eligibility flag set to true.
38. A call to apply a refund where the refund type is DISPUTE_REFUND requires that an open dispute referencing the same transaction exists with status APPROVED.
39. A call to apply a refund of any type with an amount greater than fifty thousand pence requires human approval.
40. A call to apply a refund of any type with an amount greater than the original transaction amount is not permitted.
